message: The other night, we had an unexpected blackout, and instead of panicking, I decided to turn it into a little family adventure. We gathered our flashlights and lanterns, made some hot cocoa, and played board games by the glow of our battery-powered lights. It was surprisingly cozy, and we ended up laughing and bonding in a way we hadn’t in ages. It reminded me that with a little creativity, even a power outage can be a chance to create special moments. Have you ever turned an unexpected situation into something fun?
